translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Retsiya-takota-kahaeri Jesús Kamampo-waakiri
Ikanta rawijanaki Jesús iñaapaakiri apaani atziri kamampo-waaki-tatsiri, itzima-kori ikamampo-waakitzi.
Ikantzi riyotaani-paeni: “¡Yotaanari! ¿Iitama ikamampo-waaki-tantari owakira itzimapaaki irika atziri? ¿Rooma kantakaari ikaariperotzi iriri? ¿Rooma kantakaari ikaariperotzi rirori?”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Tee roo kantakaan-teroni iyaari-peronka rirori, tee roo kantakaan-teroni iyaari-peronka ipaapate. Tema roo kantakaan-tzirori roñaahan-teetan-tyaawori ishintsinka Tajorentsi.
Tema eeniro okiteejetzi, okowa-pero-tatyaa nanteniri rantawaeri otyaanta-kinari. Rooma aririka otsireni-tanaki, tekatsi kanteroni rantawaete.
Tema eeniro nojeeki naaka jaka kepatsiki, naakataki koñeetyaa-kotziri jaawiki-jatzi.”
Ikaatakiro ikenkitha-waetaki Jesús, reewatanaki kepatsiki, ramirokaki eepichokiini kepatsi, itziritakiri rokiki kamampo-waakiri.
Ikantziri: “Piyaate pikiwa-yookityaa owaanka-naariki iiteetziri Otyaantaa-rini.” Ari ikinanaki kamampo-waakiri, ikiwaaki-tapaaka. Ikanta ipiyapaaka, aminawae-tanee kameetha.
Ikanta isheninka-paeni ikaatzi ñaapiintziriri ikowako-tantzi ipashitee-tyaari, rojampita-wakahae-yakani, ikantzi: “¿Kaarima irika jeeka-piinta-tsiri ikowako-tantzi ipashitee-tyaari?”
Eenitatsi kantatsiri: “Riitaki.” Itsipa kantatsiri: “Kaari, riiwitaka.” Ikantzi rirori: “Naakataki piñaa-piintziri.”
Ari rojampi-teeta-nakiri, ikantee-tziri: “¿Jempema pikantaaka paminan-taari kameetha?”

Ikantzi rirori: “Irinta atziri iitachari Jesús, itziritan-takinawo kepatsi nokiki, ikantakina: ‘Piyaate owaanka-naariki iiteetziri Otyaantaa-rini. Ari pikiwaaki-tyaa.’ Nokanta niyaatanaki, nokiwaaki-tapaaka janta, ari naminanee.”
Ikantee-tziri: “¿Jempema nimaeka irika atziri?” Ikantzi rirori: “Tee niyotzi.”
Rojampi-tziri Inashitantaniri-paeni Kamampo-waaki-witachari
Ikanta rahaeta-nakiri kamampo-waaki-witachari ijeekira Inashitantaniri-paeni.
Tema rootaki kiteejeri imakoryaan-teetari, imatanta-kawori Jesús itziritan-takariri rooki kepatsi, roo ikowichaa-tantaari kameetha.

Ari rapiitakiri Inashitantaniri-paeni rojampi-tziri jempe okanta ikowichaa-tantaari kameetha. Ikantanaki rirori: “Itziritan-takinawo nokiki eepichokiini kepatsi, ari niyaatanaki naaka nokiwaakita. Ari nokowichaa-tanee kameetha.”

Ari ikantzi itsipa Inashitantaniri: “Irika atziri antakirori kaari rashi Tajorentsi, tema tee romaerintantawo kitejeri imakoryaan-teetari.” Eenitatsi itsipa kantatsiri: “¿Riimi kaari-pero-shireri, eero rantziromi añaakiri?” Tema inashiyita ikantee-yakirini Inashitantaniri-paeni, tee raapatziyawakaa.
Ari rapiitakiri rojampi-tziri kamampo-waaki-witachari, ikantziri: “¿Iita pikenkishiryaari eeroka, iitama kowichaata-kahaemiri kameetha?” Ikantzi rirori: “Kamantan-taniri rirori.”
Roo kanteencha, tee ikemijanteeyini Judá-paeni riitaki kamampo-waaki-witachari irika, riitaki kowichaata-kahae-teeri kameetha. Rootaki ikaeman-takariri ipaapate ikowichaata-kahae-teeri.
Rojampi-tawakiri, ikantziri: “¿Riima pitomi irika? Pikamantena, ¿rooma itzima-kori ikamampo-waakitzi? ¿Jempema okanta ikowichaa-tantaari kameetha?”
Ikantanaki ipaapate: “Apatziro niyotzi riitaki notyomi, itzima-kori ikamampo-waakitzi.
Roo kanteencha, teera niyotzi jempe okanta ikowichaa-tantaari kameetha, tee niyotzi eejatzi iita kowichaata-kahaeriri. Pojampiteri rirori, teema antaritaki rirori, riitaki kamantemini.”
Roo ikantantari ashitariri tema ithaawan-tatyaari Judá-paeni, ikantee-yakini rirori: “Itzimi-rika kanteen-tsini Jeepatzii-toetani irika Jesús, eero noshine-teeri ikyahae apiyota-piinteeyanira.”
Rootaki ikantantari ipaapate: “Pojampiteri notyomi, antaritaki rirori.”
Ari rapiitakiro Judá-paeni ikaemaeri kamampo-waaki-witachari, ikantziri: “Pipinkathateri Tajorentsi, pikamantena kameetha, eero pipinkatha-tashitari irika atziri kaari-pero-shireri rirori.”
Ikantzi rirori: “Tee niyotzi naaka riitakirika kaari-pero-shire-rika. Apatziro niyotzi naaka kamampo-waakiri, ikowichaata-kahaana kameetha.”
Rapiitziri rojampi-tziri, ikantziri: “¿Jempe ikantakimika? ¿Oeta rantakiri ikowichaa-takaan-teemiri?”
Ikantzi kamampo-waaki-witachari: “Aritaki nokantakimi, tee pikemijantena. ¿Oetaka pikowantari napiitemiro? ¿Pikowatziima pikemijanteeyirini eeroka?”
Ari ikaweya-waetee-tanakiri kamampo-waaki-witachari, ikantee-tanakiri: “Pawentee-yaari eeroka irika atziri, rooma naakapaeni nawentee-yaawo Ikantakaantani awaejatziteni Moisés.
Tema niyoteeyini naaka ikenkitha-waeta-kaakiri Tajorentsi paerani Moisés. Riima irika atziri, tekatsi yoterini jempe ikinapaaki.”
Ari rakanaki kamampo-waaki-witachari, ikantzi: “¡Arima! Tee piyoritzi eerokapaeni jempe ikinapaaki. Rooma naaka ikowichaata-kahaana kameetha.
Tema ayoteeyini maawoeni tee ikemiri Tajorentsi antzirori kaari-perori. Apatziro ikemiro ramanani pinkatha-tziriri, ikaatzi antaneerori ikoyiri.
Tekatsi akemakote tzimatsi kowichaata-kahaeriri tzimako-tzirori ikamampo-waakitzi.
Eeromi ipoñaakawo irika atziri Tajorentsi-kinta, eero imatziromi rantakiri.”
Ikantee-tanakiri kamampo-waaki-witachari: “Kaari-perori eeroka owakira pitzima-paaki. ¿Ari pikoyi piyotaa-yiteena nimaeka naaka?” Romishitowae-takiri kamampowaakiwitachari.
Kamampo-waaki-shireri
Tema kemaki Jesús romishitowae-takiri kamampo-waaki-witachari. Ikanta iñahaeri ikinapae, rojampi-takiri, ikantziri: “¿Pawentaarima eeroka Itomi Atziri?”
Ikantzi rirori: “¡Pinkathari! Pookotenari jempe itzimi, nokoyi nawentee-yaari naaka.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Aritaki piñaakiri, tema riitaki kenkitha-waeta-kaakimiri.”
Ari rotziwerowanaka irika atziri ipinkatha-tanakiri Jesús, ikantziri: “Nawentaakimi Pinkathari.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Rootaki nopokan-takari naaka naminayi-teeri ojaawijatzi, rootaki ikowichaa-tantee-yaari kamampo-waaki-witachari. Riima ikaatzi kowichaa-witachari, ari ikamampo-waakite rirori.”
Ikanta ikemaki Inashitantaniri ikaatzi tsipatakari Jesús, ikantakiri: “¿Pikanta-tziima naaka-paeni kamampo-waakiri?”

Ari ikantzi Jesús: “Ari poshiyaarimi mawityaakiri eerokapaeni, tekatsi yakawente-mironi pantayitakiro kaari-pero-tatsiri. Rooma pikanteeyini tee pimawityaakitzi, aritaki riyakowentan-teeta-kimiro pipiyatha-takinaha.”
